new_learnings.text: The 2/3 major indices buy gate correctly flagged index-level weakness even when breadth was 2.83:1 bullish. Today market was bifurcated — broad stocks up but tech-heavy indices (深证/创业板) down. The gate prevented buying into a rotation without clarity.
new_learnings.mechanism: When index-level weakness contradicts strong breadth, the index signal reveals sector rotation risk that breadth masks. Buying into a rotating market without knowing the new leaders is dangerous.

new_learnings.text: Semiconductor went from #1 hottest sector to #1 coldest in ~5 trading days. Multiple high-quality candidates (芯源微, 伟测科技, 华峰测控, 思瑞浦, 江丰电子) are instantly disqualified by cold-sector rule. h019 confirmed: bottom-list sectors are hard no-buy zones.
new_learnings.mechanism: Sector gravity is the dominant force in momentum investing. When a sector rotates from leadership to laggard, individual stock quality cannot overcome the sector-level outflow.

new_learnings.text: RPS20 vs RPS120 divergence >40 points is a powerful warning. 华锡有色 RPS120=91.2 but RPS20=22.0 — the 3-day spike is a statistical artifact masking 20 days of dead trading. Treat extreme RPS divergence as a timing red flag.
new_learnings.mechanism: RPS20 captures the very short-term momentum. A spike on a dead stock creates a temporary RPS120 boost while RPS20 remains low, signaling the move is fresh and unconfirmed. Wait for RPS20 to catch up.

new_learnings.text: The highest-quality stocks (芯碁微装 score 9.4/0 risks, 联瑞新材 score 8.4) are often the most extended in a bull run — 50%+ above MA20. Patience on premium names is a key V2 edge. Wait for pullbacks; don't chase perfection.
new_learnings.mechanism: In momentum markets, the best companies attract the most buying pressure and become the most extended. The MA-distance rule forces discipline — even premium names must be bought at reasonable prices relative to their own trend.
